# The checks that read docs, run by the `ci` job when a change is docs-only
# (.github/actions/docs-only). Every *.md file is read by at least one of them, so a
# docs-only change still runs this list; only the seed-backed jobs are skipped.
# Each entry must be seedless. tests/ci_docs_only_test.ts fails when a test that reads
# a doc is missing here.
